request.name: pypa-sampleproject-deliberate-failure
request.description: Prove that the environment probe retains a real behavior mismatch and stops instead of converting a nonzero command into successful evidence.

commands.description: Build and install the exact checked-out sampleproject source tree.
Demand the wrong add_one result so the process must fail observably.
argv: from sample.simple import add_one; actual=add_one(5); assert actual == 999, f"expected 999, got {actual}"

commands.description: This command proves that execution stops at the failed contract boundary.
Record the exact SWE-ReX server version inside the image.
Read effective Linux process and cgroup isolation limits.
argv: import json,pathlib; status=dict(line.split(':',1) for line in pathlib.Path('/proc/self/status').read_text().splitlines() if ':' in line); paths=['/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max','/sys/fs/cgroup/pids.max','/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max']; result={'CapEff':status.get('CapEff','').strip(),'NoNewPrivs':status.get('NoNewPrivs','').strip(),**{p:pathlib.Path(p).read_text().strip() if pathlib.Path(p).exists() else 'unavailable' for p in paths}}; print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True))
